items.author: letrune.bsky.social
items.context: Hi. I wonder, is there a cozy town building game you know where you can just build and explore? Like grabbing the building system of Conan Exiles or such and just going to town (hah!) With it? Not a dedicated city builder like Sim City, but this more scalable thing?
items.text: Dinkum is worth a look: you build up a small town and explore a big open world at your own pace, with no pressure to rush. Palia also has a lot of free-form building if you want something with a bit more community feel.
items.verify: Проверить: Dinkum даёт свободную постройку и исследование мира (а не только готовые дома), и Palia бесплатная с домом, который можно строить и обставлять.
